title.text: Productivity growth and the change in churn are barely related in either period
subtitle: Change in real GVA per hour against change in the job reallocation rate between consecutive periods (2004–10, 2011–17, 2018–23).

Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS Subregional productivity (June 2025); authors' calculations.
